newsitem.title: USA: International Network IPO pricing due.
newsitem.headline: International Network IPO pricing due.

text.p: The hot initial public offering of International Network Services is expected to be priced this morning, according to underwriter Morgan Stanley.
"This is my pick of the week," said Vince Slavin, who tracks IPOs for Cantor Fitzgerald. "It could rise maybe two in the aftermarket."
But analysts said they would be surprised if the deal priced above range in the moderate pricing environment of the last few months.
The company plans to offer 2.5 million shares in an estimated range of $9 to $11 each.

International Network provides a life cycle of services for complex enterprise network including development with 435 employees in 17 cities. The company's clients include AT&T Corp, Ascend Communications Inc, Georgia-Pacific Corp, and Sprint Corp.
The company posted profits of $1.7 million on revenues of $44.1 million for the fiscal year ended June 30, 1996. For the prior year, it posted a loss of $108,000 on revenues of $15.5 million.
